forbidden_shortcuts: Do not replace or wrap the php executable
Do not use command-line -d overrides or environment variables

observable_symptom.command: configured=$(awk -F= '/^[[:space:]]*html_errors[[:space:]]*=/{gsub(/[[:space:]]/,"",$2); print tolower($2); exit}' /etc/php/8.1/cli/php.ini); effective=$(php -i | awk -F'=> ' '/^html_errors =>/{gsub(/[[:space:]]/,"",$2); print tolower($2); exit}'); test "$configured" = "$effective"

fail_to_pass.description: The configured html_errors value agrees with PHP CLI's effective value

pass_to_pass.description: PHP CLI remains installed, loads the declared configuration file, and executes code
